gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=1

This PR adds an Export CSV button to the reports page that downloads the report as a CSV file, emails the file to the person who asked for it, and records the export in the audit log. The button, the email delivery, and the audit event are all in place with tests; the export deliberately includes the 12 columns shown by default rather than all 40 table columns, as the spec explains; and the under-5-second target on production data can only be checked after merge, though the 100-row paging limit and 4-second cutoff behind it are built and tested. You are the author of this PR.

Nothing blocks merging. One smaller point does not block merging: the export handler pages through report rows with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper in lib/page.ts, so the two copies of paging logic could drift apart later (src/api/export.ts, line 31). The fix nits step can take care of it. You cannot approve your own PR, so approval is not offered.

I recommend merge because nothing blocks merging and the checks passed in CI on the commit being reviewed.

Pick one:
1. merge - squash-merge this PR on GitHub, pinned to the commit being reviewed. [recommended]
2. fix nits - replace the handler's own paging loop with the shared paging helper in one repair round, push it, wait for the checks, and return to this menu.
3. stop - leave the PR open and the worktree as it is.
